location_description: Monroeville is a municipality with home rule status in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. Located about 10 miles east of Pittsburgh, Monroeville is a suburb with mixed residential and commercial developments. As of the 2020 census, Monroeville was home to 28,640 people.
